day.headline: A Rooster day — Ox and Snake are in step.

reasons: Ox and Rooster share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Left side's for walking. Take it at pace, no apologies.

reasons: Rooster's own day — your energy runs high
signs.message: Don't hide in the back row today. Walk down front.

reasons: Goat sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer

signs.motif: a delivery box not broken down
signs.message: That box by the door. Flatten it, thirty seconds, gone.

reasons: Snake and Rooster share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: You said yes twice for Saturday. Pick one, tell them today.
